name: tot-stock-desktop
description: Application de bureau TOT Stock (Windows, macOS, Linux) avec impression silencieuse d'étiquettes
author: TOT Inventory & Scan Edition

scripts.dist: node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never && node scripts/generate-checksums.mjs
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never && node scripts/generate-checksums.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && electron-builder --mac dmg --universal --config electron-builder.yml --publish never && node scripts/generate-checksums.mjs
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never && node scripts/generate-checksums.mjs
